The focused tests pass, but the patch changes the workflow-visible failure type without migration guidance. Workflows that match the existing type can miss these failures.

review_comments.body:
[P2] Preserve the existing MCP activity failure type

With the default Temporal Java failure converter, a direct `McpError` previously reached workflows with type `io.modelcontextprotocol.spec.McpError`. This wrapper changes the recorded type to `McpError`, so workflows that match the original type in `ApplicationFailure.getType()` will stop taking their MCP error-handling branch for these four codes. Keep the original failure type while marking it non-retryable, as the Java Google ADK sibling does, or call out the breaking change and give guidance for in-flight runs (AGENTS.md:75).
